method: Deterministic replay plus exact memoized order counting; no player testing.
limits: Difficulty is editorial and technical, not calibrated with players.
Concept occurrence is extracted from a certified witness. Exact precedence sets describe all winning orders, but they do not prove that every observed visual motif occurs in every solution.
The finite generator can eventually repeat. Recent structure/family history reduces repeats; no global infinite uniqueness claim.
Gaps, reflection and uniform scale are ignored by equivalence normalization. Tutorial levels2 and5 intentionally revisit levels1 and3.
